text:
The independent European Commission JRC forest map shows forest in 2020 across **98% of the area** where Hansen mapped 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021. A later year was also observed in the annual series, satisfying the method’s corroboration rule.

Uruguay’s 2021 MGAP forest map provides context: it classified 68.1 hectares of the loss area as planted pine forest, none as native forest, and 13.2 hectares as outside mapped forest.

This evidence supports the tree-cover loss finding, but does not establish its cause or whether it involved deforestation or land-use change.
